login.title: Sign in
login.intro: See your bookings, pay the balance and update traveller details.
login.oauthError: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again or use your email.
login.lookup: Booked without an account? You can still open your booking from the confirmation email.
login.deleted: Your account has been deleted and you have been signed out. Thank you for travelling with us.
login.deletionReceived: We have received your request to delete the account. Our team will complete it and let you know.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: One account keeps all your journeys in one place. Bookings made with the same email appear once you confirm it.
register.marketing: Send me letters about new journeys (unsubscribe at any time).
register.unavailable: Accounts cannot be created right now. You can still book and open your booking from the confirmation email.
register.sent: If this email has no account yet, we have sent a confirmation link. Open your inbox to finish.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email. We will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, we have sent a link to reset the password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Once saved, other devices that are signed in will be signed out.
reset.expired: This page opens only from the reset link in your email, within 15 minutes. Please ask for a new link.

status.sent: If the details match, we have sent you an email.
status.invalid_credentials: The email or password is not right.
status.unconfirmed: This email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the confirmation email, or sign up again to get a new one.
status.turnstile: We could not verify your browser. Please try again.
status.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
status.unavailable: This is not available right now. Please try again later.
status.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
status.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.invalidEmail: This email does not look right.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.samePassword: The new password must differ from the old one.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess or has been leaked. Please choose another.
errors.wrongPassword: The current password is not right.
errors.sameEmail: This is already your account's email.
errors.consentRequired: Please agree to the privacy policy.

StaffAuth.title: Sign in to the admin
StaffAuth.intro: For staff. Customers sign in on the account page.
StaffAuth.staffOauth: Staff accounts sign in with email and password.
StaffAuth.updateIntro: Choose a password for your staff account. Other sessions will be signed out.

errors.link: The link is not valid or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
errors.inactive: This account is no longer active.
errors.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
